dues.title: Dues / Debts
dues.description: Manage period charges for apartments and units.
dues.inactiveProperty: This property is inactive. You can review history; activate it before creating or cancelling charges.
dues.phaseBoundary: Debt is linked to the unit. Choose Unit, Tenant or Owner as debtor. Party history is recorded at assessment creation; move-out cancellation requires manager approval.

dues.emptyHelp: Change the filters or create an assessment for active units.

payments.title: Receipts
payments.description: Record payments, allocate them to debts and review collection history.
payments.manualHelp: Record cash or a bank transfer already received. This form does not debit a bank account or initiate a transfer.

expenses.title: Expenses and Budget
expenses.pageHelp: Record actual expenses and compare monthly receipts with category budgets.
expenses.expenseHelp: Record an actual expense. Cancel incorrect entries with a reason to preserve history.
expenses.budgetHelp: Save the planned amount and explanation. Every change is retained as a new revision.
expenses.amountInvalid: Amount must be positive, at most 99999999.99, with up to two decimal places.
expenses.budgetAmountInvalid: Budget must be zero or positive, at most 99999999.99, with up to two decimal places.
expenses.dateInvalid: Enter an expense date from 2000 onwards; future dates are not allowed.
expenses.descriptionRequired: Description is required and must be at most 500 characters.
expenses.referenceInvalid: Document reference must be at most 100 characters.

expenses.budgetReplayed: This revision was already recorded; the current budget is shown.

expenses.ambiguous: The result is uncertain. Check the list; retrying identical content uses the same request identifier.

expenses.cancelHelp: This expense is removed from actual totals. Its amount, document reference and history remain.
expenses.inactiveProperty: History is available for an inactive property; expenses, cancellation and budget changes are disabled.
expenses.overviewHelp: All categories for the selected month are shown. List searches and category filters do not change this overview. Cancelled entries are excluded from actual totals.
expenses.periodInvalid: Choose a valid YYYY-MM period between 2000 and 9998.
expenses.incomeHelp: Receipts recorded this month; accruals are not income.
expenses.netHelp: Difference between recorded amounts; this is not a bank balance.
expenses.varianceHelp: Total defined budget minus all expenses this month.
expenses.emptyHelp: Change filters or record a new actual expense.
expenses.budgetTableHelp: Set a monthly plan for each category. An unset budget differs from an explicit zero plan. Revisions preserve history.
